author: Cthulhu5000
text:
Short: good, but not great. Definitely not a must-play. Technical problems.

I. Technical.
- Game does NOT have a bad optimization. However, setting are too complex (more than 20 variables) and auto-choice is bad. After an optimization guide I've got a best looking PC game running on stable 60 fps.
- DRM. Well, I suppose it's DRM causing problems. I've got crashes from the game and just before the crash I was seeing on a screen the situation where I was like 20 minutes ago. Also, (I bought at EGS) I was receiving save files conflict, where save at the cloud was MORE recent than local. Many stuff is server-based here, I guess.

II. Singleplayer.
- There are 3 games with longest story, that I have played: The Witcher III, GTA V and RDR II.
I am not keen on fantasy, but after WIII's 120+ hours I've read not only witcher's books but all author's bibliography and now have a high regard of polish fantasy writers.
I am not superfan of criminal drama, but after GTA V's 50+ hours I've searched and looked every Scorcese's, De Palma's and Mann's overlooked masterpieces and some of 80's action movies.
I am super big fan of western genre: from Stagecoach to The Shootist, from Django to Django Unchained I've watched every notable western movie, black-white, color and of course, Technicolor. And after RDRII's 80+ hours I am kinda meh…
- Yeah, it's 1899, almost end of the Wild West in USA (1st period is before telegraph and railroads, 2nd is circa Civil War, 3rd is afterwards, 4th is Mexican Revolution), so it does hurt an atmosphere, it is lacking golden age shenanigans.
- Some missions are great, direct quotations from great movies, but there many just soulless stuff copypasted from GTA.
- Weapons are great and bad simultaneously. Rockstar did a great job and spoiled it after. Great reloading animations were done and than speed up, idk, in 100 times. So, your game hero reload gate-loading Colt or even cap and ball with amount of time required to reload modern pistol. It downs an importance of each shot to a meh I'll just reload in 2 seconds. There are btw world's first pistols and some newer weapons, not really common at that time in those places, and it's hurting atmosphere too, really bad. Making a western into GTA is a bad thing.
- You travel with a gang, there are plenty of characters, half of the names of those you won't remember in the end of the game. Also, many other characters are flat, only serving some purpose. For example, there are Indians, and Indians' quests, but it's feels like just so R* can say: "We have Indians in our western". Guys, for example, there are too few Mexicans. So what? Western can tell many stories, the overall percent coverage of all possible topics is not what is important, it's theirs quality, and game lacks it, really bad.
- Your actions affect your story based on your honor level. However, it's too easy to be good. Unless, you murder folks for 5 $. Or doesn't confess your sins to Reverend Fish. Just let it go, off the hook, my son.
- And yet, game is too long, twice longer than GTA V, and exact same length too long.
Overall, script-writing is worse than in GTA V. I kinda guess, after all those years with modern criminal plots they've achieved some skills and trying to use these skills everywhere.
- Economy is broken. Missions propose you hard choices about taking or not taking like 20 $ from a poor fellow. C'mon, just go find some gold bars, 500 $ each and you will not have any problems with money, just frustration from unsatisfying dull unrewarding copypasted repeating quests.
- Open world works on scripts. When they work it's impressive as hell. But they tend to broke. IMHO, it could've been a firts R* RPG easily, with like plus 25% efforts added to all of this, but meh.

III. Online.
I am not really a modern online gamer, nor have I played a RDO much, but it does feel good.
There are pay-to-win, but it works only in PVP. Mundane, unpolished and easily avoidable PVP in mostly PVE-focused game with role-playing flavor.
However, DRM (p.I) can crash your game just when you were doing your mission, or having a good hand in poker. In singleplayer I just reload, it's not a big deal, but it's a lot of pain in online, because you must do it again from the very start.
An of course, you do grinding a lot.
Protagonists of RDO are mute. All of them. It feels strange and awkward.
From all mini-games from single you can play only poker.

In the end, after writing this review, I still can't recommend to buy or to avoid this game, even if you like westerns. If you don't have anything other to play, maybe?

author: muldjord
text:
This game is breathtaking! On all levels! The details, the stories, the side-quests, the graphics, the sound, the music. It all fits so well together that I almost get lost in this world and don't want to leave it.

I think it's the best display of player freedom I've experienced in a game. You can play it exactly as you want to. Go hunting, fishing, exploring. Visit small towns, big towns, cabins in the woods. Towns burned to the ground. People building houses that actually get built as time passes in the game. There's also a smorgasbord of comedic, shocking and harrowing random encounters to deal with. The game never feels boring or empty. It's the one game where I'd rather ride to the opposite side of the map for the 50th time, than I'd use fast travel. You can fast travel a bit later in the game. But I rarely do! I simply enjoy just riding and stumbling upon weird stuff I can experience.

I absolutely love everything about this game.

author: Gwynceit
text:
У этой игры медленный и медитативный, но в тоже время глубокий геймплей, который не всем придётся по вкусу, нужно просто научиться им наслаждаться и тогда получаешь от игры массу удовольствия. В ней отличный сюжет с охерительной режиссурой, развитию которого способствуют основательно прописанные персонажи, которым хочется сопереживать и помогать. И помимо него есть множество различных мест интереса и побочных заданий разной степени проработанности. так что в игре всегда можно себя чем-то занять. Но у РДР, как и любой другой игры, есть свои минусы, которые относятся как к самой структуре в принципе, так и к особенностям ПК-версии: бесконечная езда на лошади быстро надоедает, а далеко не в любую точку карты можно добраться фасттрэвэлом, менюшки довольно таки неудобные, управление порой выводит из себя так же, как и немалое количество менеджмента, за которым не особо интересно следить, эмбиенты мне показались посредственными, отличие одной лошади от другой сложно прочувствовать, да и оптимизация подкачала, особенно на выходе, сейчас игра идет на моей системе (GTX1060 6gb, I5-8500, 16gb оперативки) стабильно в 60 фпс на средне-высоких с некоторыми графическими багами. Но почти все минусы незначительны по сравнению с тем наслаждением, которое я получил от прохождения этой игры, поэтому игра заслуживает свои 9/10.
P.S. Онлайн относительно неплохой, в нем немало контента и Рокстары пока не обдирают своих игроков как липу, но пвп в нём убогое и несбалансированное.

author: jah1337
text:
Not gonna talk about technical issues this game has (had, actually, once they patched it 1 month after release). It's more about the game itself, it's quite boring, always the same uninteresting mission mechanics.
Even the map itself is badly made (you go from snowy mountains to 30°C Louisiana-style swamps with alligators in 5 min horse-back trips). It's not that beautiful to look at, like most people are saying, it's very last-gen (which is understandable, given that it was developed for consoles).
The first 1/4 of the game is ok, you get to "build your character" and discover the story. But after that it gets to the "more of the same" stuff, going back and forth on the same paths with the same missions and characters. I guess the devs didn't get to play The Witcher 3...
I really forced myself to finish the game so i could uninstall it quickly (man those 2 epilogue chapters... i don't know who designed them but he did an awful job :/ i almost gave up at one point)
And the soundtrack is one of the worst ever made for a high-budget game in recent history.

So I'm still looking forward to a good epic western game.

author: Aleuvian
text:
Red Dead Redemption 2 is an excellent game held back by technical limitations on the PC release.

It features a spectacular story with characters one can genuinely become invested in, a plethora of choices which have lasting consequences, and even ways to atone, but not undo, mistakes you may have made along the way.

As for the direct port of the game from console to PC:

-- Movement is clunky, unresponsive and at times makes little sense. Horses don't like taking four directional inputs and prefer a radial input offered by a controller, and this makes them unwieldy to control. It feels like the horse tries to go in the camera direction, ignoring your key inputs, then suddenly switches to following the key inputs or will occasionally stop and turn back to favor roads.

-- Shooting becomes tedious when the character won't automatically cycle their firearms. This becomes especially tedious with repeaters, where gunfights become a fight between who can break their M1 button the quickest.

-- An extra launcher, even for the Steam release, is entirely unnecessary. This dependency makes updating the game difficult and occasionally frustrating, as it can completely corrupt the game files if the Rockstar launcher fails an update. This update process doesn't warn a computer shutdown and isn't alerted on Steam, either.

author: error8
text:
I'm writing this review because it's just not fair to see this game user score here. 4.5 coming from people that were early adopters and had issues with the game, or others that expect their 2016 flagship GPUS and 10 year old quad cores, to take this game at ultra settings with 100 fps+.
First, this is the best looking game on PC, period. Nothing like this has been made until now. So, being so sophisticated graphically, with some very taxing features, it's normal that at some settings even a 2080ti  struggles. It was the same with GTA5, remember???This is not lack of optimization, it's more like the game pushing the graphics forward. In one or two years, new GPUs will handle it just fine. Don't be lazy, use the optimization guides on youtube and you can play this game at 60+fps no problem and still looking better then it's console counterpart.
Second, I've been reading about a lot of crashes, people being unable to play it, but this was back in November. Ok, I get it, it's not a pleasure to pay a premium to have a game that doesn't work day one. But have some patience, one month later almost everything got fixed up. I never had one crash in the last month since I bought it. This game is massive and it's not easy to make it behave perfectly since the beginning, because we have so many combinations of computer parts and software in our systems.

Putting all this aside, the game is gorgeous, has a great gameplay, it's incredibly immersive, lots of things to do and a lot to learn about (SUA 1899). There is nothing really I can complain about it, I just don't want it to ever finish.

author: ralast
text:
Update: 2.5 months after release: Playable, but there are still lots of annoying bugs.

A great game, but an unpolished port. Not nearly as good as GTA V PC. Seems like Rockstar rushed this out.

Definitely play the console versions if you can. Don't wait for Rockstar to fix the PC version, because they never fix their bugs.

A few crashes. Graphical glitches--water looks like TV static and there's a thing that's floating in front of the player character but is "stuck" there. UI bugs as well. Mouse cursor sometimes disappears. Mouse sometimes doesn't click. Mouse sometimes "clicks" when it shouldn't. If you unpause, your horse continues moving, but you can't steer it because the game ignores some input for another 3 seconds, so your horse might crash stupidly. Lots of random freezes for 5-10 seconds. Several map icons don't show up when they should.

Some bugs that may not be port-related as well. Some typos in the subtitles. One or two minor side quests don't appear.

Very high graphics requirements. With a GTX 1080, I can only play at 1440p, high settings (not ultra). Basically no one can play at 4K.

Strange 'cloud save conflict'. Might lead to data loss.

Rockstar support is useless. Some agents barely speak English. Some don't seem to know the game's name. Most just tell you to clear your cache, which I'm pretty sure has never fixed anything for anyone.

text:
Абсолютно наплевательское отношение Rockstar к ПК аудитории. Эта игра на данный момент выглядит лишь как любительский порт с консоли.

Теперь о самой игре:

Ладно, пропустим момент с падающим фреймрейтом, уже исправлено(хотя, вроде как, не у всех). Но уже звоночек.
- Графика в ААА-проекте 2019(пусть даже 2018) года хуже, чем в GTA V 2015 года, или, как минимум, на том же уровне, а системные требования, при этом, намного выше.(+- ультра пресет, 1920х1080).
- Проблемы с запуском: чертов RSC иногда просто не дает войти в игру по причине различного рода ошибок, а иногда вообще говорит, что не запущен клиент Steam, с которого и была запущена игра.
- Прогрузка в реальном времени: предметы время от времени появляются из ниоткуда, вроде лошадей, вывесок, а один раз и целого этажа здания! И это при том, что игра стоит на SSD...
Также и после загрузки игры - сначала появляется голова Артура, а потом все остальное: тело, здания и т.п.
- Из плюсов пока не могу выделить ничего, так как по причине кривого лаунчера не могу оценить игру в полной мере. Отыграл всего 2 с небольшим часа. Но единственное чувство, посещавшее меня за эти два часа - это скука. Серьёзно, мне не особо нравится сама концепция этой игры, но я искренне хотел дать ей шанс.

И что же я(мы все) получил/-и? Как по мне - полнейшее разочарование.

Rockstar должно быть стыдно выпускать ЭТО в таком состоянии!

На 14.12.2019 то, от чего у меня полыхает больше всего:
Rockstar выпускает игру в steam на месяц позже, чем в EGS, хапнув деньжат за эксклюзивность.
Мало того, в steam выходит абсолютно кривая *****, в которую невозможно играть. Как в EGS, но только спустя месяц, ну не смешно ли?
Мало? То ли еще будет: меньше чем через 10 дней Rockstar выпускает патч, который ломает игру и плюсом ко всему вешает на неё 20% скидку, скрывшись в закат с нашими кровными шекелями.
Если бы была номинация "Анти Игра Года", то я знаю, кто взял бы гран-при.
Накипело.

Резюмируя:
1. Не покупайте это, не повторяйте наших ошибок.
2. RDR2 на ПК - очередное доказательство того, что критикам в 2019 верить не стоит.

На всякий случай, оставлю конфиг системы:
CPU: I5 9600K
VCard: RTX 2070 Super
RAM: 16GB, 3000MHz
ROM: SATA SSD 1TB
Все драйвера последней версии.

author: missieloke
text:
Por 240 reais em um jogo que esperei 1 ano é brincadeira né Rockstar?
Um processador i7 4770k, GTX 970 pra jogar com tudo no low e constantemente ter engasgadas é sacanagem.

Problemas (os que 5000 caracteres permitem)

De nada adianta uma campanha excelente se não consigo jogar ela. Na primeira semana do jogo era simplesmente uma renderização inexistente. Quando saiu um patch depois de 1 semana, deixando-a menos pior.
O modo online, que mantém a vida útil do game MUITO maior do que a campanha, não tem quase NADA pra fazer. São missões repetitivas, entediantes que no segundo dia você já larga o game.
Os problemas na mecânica do jogo são infinitos. Por exemplo se você der ALT+TAB e voltar pro jogo, seu cavalo ou personagem começa a andar em círculos.
São diversas as vezes que já perdi missões por causa do laço atravessar o personagem que eu queria atingir.
Engasgadas constantes, principalmente na hora de troca de tiros. Isso ocorre tanto no online, quanto na campanha.
O acampamento sendo desmontado aleatoriamente no meio do game. Além da constante dificuldade que é em instalar um novo acampamento, que é extremamente bugado. As vezes tenho que trocar de sessão 2x para conseguir monta-lo.
Cavalo constantemente tropeçando em objetos que você tenta desviar, mas mesmo assim ele acaba tomando um caminho diferente da ordem dada e caindo. Já perdi diversas missões por causa disso.
Na hora de mirar em alguém, a mira "puxa" para o cavalo ao invés de mirar a arma em um inimigo, fazendo você virar peneira sem você conseguir reagir.
As expansões do online pelo visto vão ser aquele "feijão com arroz" padrão da Rockstar no GTA V. Constantemente serão lançadas missões de abastecimento de um local para vender o produto disso, sempre lançando uma mais vantajosa que a outra.
Um "pay to win" no online, disponibilizando vários equipamentos antecipadamente por ouro, fazendo assim o pessoal comprar com micro-transações, pois as pessoas não tem o dia inteiro para jogar e farmar dinheiro e RP pra upar.
Preço das coisas no online ridiculamente caros e com pouco conteúdo. Assim como nas atualizações do GTA V, que um pneu custa quase $200,000), uma decoração de sela no cavalo pode custar $150.
O laço é feito do mesmo material que papel higiênico. Pra resolver isso colocaram o "laço reforçado", que salvo engano custa $380. Sua única função é de ao invés do alvo se soltar a cada 2 minutos, o tempo passa a ser 2 minutos e 30 segundos.
Problemas com queda de conexão constante, perdendo muitas missões por causa disso (tenho certeza que o problema não é com a internet, já que não tenho problema com nenhum outro jogo).
Personagens do online a cavalo fechando o seu caminho diversas vezes, e você não conseguir desviar o seu cavalo e acaba caindo. Isso em uma missão de perseguição é extremamente frustrante.
Nerf absurdo dos loots em personagens que você saqueia no online, quase não compensando fazê-lo, se não fosse pelos itens de colecionador.
Você só consegue desbloquear missões de ofício (caçador de recompensas, mercador e colecionador) se para cada um destes você pagar 15 ouros. Isso é o cúmulo do ridículo! Quem não compra a versão de 280 reais ou não pegou na pré-venda e ganhou 50 ouros, é basicamente forçado a jogar por SEMANAS pra conseguir juntar a quantidade necessária de ouro. A única opção é comprar as versões citadas acima ou por micro-transação.
A honra do seu personagem é extremamente difícil de abaixar, limitando assim a história da campanha do online, forçando você a pagar 3 ouros pra reduzir sua honra.
Não é possível assaltar trens e estabelecimentos no online.
Algumas muitas vezes na hora de derrubar alguém para amarrar a pessoa, o personagem ou desiste da ação e fica encarando o alvo, virando peneira.
Talvez o ponto mais triste é de não conseguir finalizar um animal ferido utilizando a faca de caça apertando E no online, assim como na campanha. Então você tem que encarar o animal ferido agonizando até a morte, e ainda no final receber desonra por “sangramento”, sendo que você não tem opção sem estragar o couro dele.
A carroça de caça foi com certeza uma excelente adição, que poderia ter também na campanha. Mas pelo amor de Deus, o cavalo tropeça em qualquer degrau e destrói a carroça. Ainda bem que você não perde as carcaças dentro dela, mas é chato o cavalo tropeçar e sair andando como se nada tivesse acontecido pra longe da sua carroça. Então você tem que pagar $8 pra concertar, ou contratar um seguro de $125.
As missões do online além de serem repetitivas e sem conteúdo nenhum, mesmo as desbloqueadas com ouro, pagam muito pouco, na casa de $10 por 15 minutos de game. Isso é totalmente ridículo!
A única coisa que realmente você consegue fazer dinheiro no online é caçar itens colecionáveis, que é um saco.
Entre outros que não couberam!!

author: Carface
text:
God of War 3 is not good enough to make me buy a PS4 :P

TBH I've been waiting for this game for a long time, and I am not disappointed. It got great graphics, cinematic cut scene and good gameplay. My PC comes with Windows 10 home edition, 32GB memory, GeForce 1070 and Intel i7 8086k. Unfortunately my SSD space is limited, so I installed it on my Seagate 1TB HD. The game launched reliably with no slowdowns and no CTD while playing. However there is an autosave glitch, I ended up getting stuck on autosave question, forcing me to shut the game through task manager.

The good, the games comes with multiple manual saves. I hate Far Cray 5 autosave only, it makes multiple playthrough tough. Red Dead 2 allows you to save anytime and anywhere. However, just like GTAV, when you load the game, it will load to the closest location and anything around you such as stolen stagecoach will disappears. The immersion and attention to details is amazing, beautifully recreates a fictionalized wild west.

The Bad, Everyone knows Take 2 arrogance, specially with the Borderlands 3 drama. Take 2 forced you to buy the game in their own store front by delaying competing distribution from Steam and even Epic Game Store. At least they offer you some games, if you never owned one. This maybe a dirty trick to lure people to their storefront with very small library of games, reminds me of Bethesda.

Despite the fact I never experienced any performance issues because my PC spec is fairly beefed up. The recommended spec may not guarantee reliable gameplay. Don't even think about running on minimum spec, it will lose your mind, One guy who complained about performance issues have a superior 1080, while my PC only have 1070 and have no problem with a mixture of medium, high and ultra settings with DSR resolution of 3200 X 1800. I do run into an intermittent slow down issues with GTAV, it appears to be a display driver bug, it can be solved by ALT-ENTER twice.

author: a_wild_dandan
text:
There are enough reviews lamenting the performance of this title, so I'd like to alternatively explain why I just dislike the game. TL;DR: It's decent story wrapped in bad gameplay.

There's a lot to like about RDR2. The world is stunning, the voice acting is superb, and the story is compelling. Past that, RDR2 has simply been a frustrating experience for myriad reasons:

* Gameplay: I've logged 100+ hours in-game, and I bet 70% of that has been crawling excruciatingly slowly through camp or holding `W` on horseback to get from point A to point B. It's cute for the first few hours when you're still admiring the natural splendor of the game world or hunting pelts, but it quickly becomes an eye-rolling time debit. I took to browsing Reddit during these excursions. Getting to the fun bits became an absolute chore. Fast travel (and the occasional horse riding montages) mildly attenuates the issue, but it isn't nearly enough.

Traveling aside, missions are brittle, feeling like a rails shooter. Wander too far from the precious yellow path/area and it's an instant fail-state. Retry checkpoint. Get off your horse inches short of the yellow X target? Unacceptable. Get back on your horse and travel those extra **** trigger the animation of you getting off the horse. Ugh.

* The missions: "We have to get the MacGuffin! Oh no, there's more resistance than we thought! ~Shootout~ Wew! We made it out of there alive!" That's nearly every mission in RDR2. This template quickly loses its charm. There are a few genuinely great missions. Trying to find your comrade while drunk in a saloon was hilarious. Trudging through a bayou looking for a mysteriously disappeared worker while a terror lurks below was genuinely tense. But these are the depressingly sparse exceptions amid the overwhelming permutation of boring, samey shootouts.

* Controls: The key mapping is needlessly bizarre. Closing context menus uses `Esc`, except when it uses `F`. Right click to focus iron-sights to shoot an enemy while near your horse? Enjoy instead auto-locking onto your horse instead! Fisticuffs are done via `F` and `R`. (Ugh.) There are gobs of awkward interactions that could've so easily been polished. Moreover, if you play in first person mode, your viewport is constantly hijacked by jarring character animations. It's fun to press `W` and have your character briefly run sideways. The lowest mouse sensitivity is *way* too high. (I had to fiddle with the DPI on my mouse to make the game playable at my preferred sensitivity.)

Folks have been having significant technical issues. I have too. I've had crashes, the overlay bug, poor optimization, etc. But to me, that's the least damning thing: even if it ran flawlessly, it just isn't that great ****.

I did watch a youtube video that explained the video settings, I know I'm getting like 45fps but it feels alright with a controller and I've played worse.  Considering my antiquated hardware, I'm really shocked it looks and runs as well as it does.  The game itself is everything I hoped it would be, I never got to really play the first.  The world is gorgeous, huge, and diverse.  The characters and story are absolutely epic.  The mechanics are intuitive and not overdone.  Best $60 I've spent on a video game in years, but maybe I'm just a cowboy that was born 100 years too late?  Good on Rockstar for bringing this one to PC, I couldn't be happier with it.  I hope they make a part **** release it on PC of course.

text: So, I preface this review with, game looks down right beautiful. It is an absolute marvel to just sit on a horse and gaze out into the vast openness that is this game. It is one of if not the best looking games that has ever been released onto PC in the last few years. This game has honestly become the new Crysis, I guarantee that this game will be the standard pc benchmark for years to come. Now, onto why I'm not giving this a 9 or a 10, the performance in this game is not great. Secondly, the controls out of the box is janky at best. Granted, they aren't the worse controls I've used, trust me, i've used much worse, but RDR2 is certainly up there. But besides this games downfalls, it is easily the best game to come to the pc. If the controls get better or the performance improves in the future, I will update my score, but for now this game definitely earns an 8/10.

author: Codeis
text:
Seems like people are really mad because of this poor launch and R* drm-launcher. Have to admit I was disappointed aswell but waited 1 week, downloaded some patches and now it runs fine for me. I have had like 3 crashes in 100h and some minor stuttering here and there. Optimization seems to be another isssue for many, but on my system (i7 2600K@4,5GHz and GTX1070) it runs just fine on 1440p mixed ultra to medium settings. I can get 30-45fps depending of the scenery and thats perfectly fine for me in slow pased open world game.

Anyways the game itself is just pure gold. Story and characters, well there has been enough talk about these, so I have to add one very noticeable thing for me, which is sound. This game has easily the best and most detailed sound in any game ever made. Just standing in the woods you can hear all around you these different animals, swaying trees in the wind, distant waterfall and trains. Not only has it perfect ambient sound but the soundtrack is very good aswell and makes many missions unforgettable. Mission structure is played out with basic R* way following orders: go here, stand here, press this button, shoot them etc. but honestly I was not expecting any dramatic change to that, imo it works fine for story driven game. This game has so much content that I could spend 200h in it without ever getting bored. All things concidered well worth 60€ after patches.

I preordered the game, payed pretty much, sacrificed the integrity of my library on steam in favour of Rockstar game launcher and I got.. Nothing. A bitter sensation of being a complete fool. Now a few words about the game. It is 11/10, seriously. The plot, the game mechanics, the everything is amazing. There are no words to describe it, you MUST play it.

So. I think Rockstar HAVE TO APPOLOGIZE for this buggy non-sense and give some sort of reward for those who pre-ordered the game and was down by its state. This will at least show they care more than just like "hey, we made a patch, here you go, shut up". Correct me if I'm wrong.

author: Hasbrin
text:
I am beyond disappointed in this game.

I'll start by saying, I have a computer that meets the recommended system build, and when the game runs, it is relatively smooth with relatively few FPS drops, I don't have a super beefy computer, but generally the game runs well... that is when it is running.

After two weeks of patches, multiple driver updates, editing the launch settings (as Rockstar recommends), the game still crashes at random intervals. In addition, just getting the game to launch is a nightmare, I often spend over an hour fighting with the Rockstar launcher just to get the game up and running. I constantly get activation errors, despite playing now for over 20hrs, and the game will often crash while loading.

This game is beyond broken, and I have given up hope that I will be able to play it. Even if you have a mid-tier computer that meets the recommended build I'd pass on the game for the foreseeable future. Maybe I'll be able to play in 3 years when I can afford a top of the line computer.

I'm giving it 8 instead of 10 just because of the technical issues at launch. author: Necromorph1990
text: Просто отвратительная оптимизация) В первый день релиза запустить не мог из-за ошибки лаунчера. Ладно, это пережил, ровно через сутки пофиксили, обновив лаунчер, и выпустив патч. Были установлены драйвера нвидия, специально заточенные под игру. Запустилось, все более-менее сносно игралось, после длительных пребываниях в разделе настроек графики.,были подобраны оптимальные настройки. Далее нвидия выпустили свежий драйвер, который, добавил порядка 5-7 фпс. И Тут-же рокстар анонсировали патч. Обрадовавшись этой новости, оставил игру до следующего дня, в надежде на добавку еще пары фпс. Как оказалось позже, надеялся я зря, данный патч отнял порядка 10 фпс, т. е. игра стала работать хуже, чем на релизе. К счастью с фризами и вылетами особых проблем не испытывал, поэтому порывшись в настройках графики, и снизив еще некоторые пункты, получил терпимый фпс, и продолжил проходить дальше. Далее выходит еще один патч, думаю, ну теперь может добавят чуть-чуть производительности, либо вернут те фпс, что, отняли с прошлым патчем. Не тут то было, вместо оптимизации, порезали дальность прорисовки следов на грязи, и появления таких объектов, как, дилижансы, и тени от них, при этом снова сбросив все настройки по дефолту, и самое интересное, что на фпс это никак не отразилось, зато появились какие-то мерцания текстур. Поэкспериментировав вновь с настройками, игра и вовсе перестала работать, после загрузки просто черный экран, хотя звуки и управление работает. Сразу напрашивается вопрос, за что, я вам отдал 2500р., за бета тест? Каждый ваш патч, делает и без того плохо оптимизированную игру, вовсе неиграбельной. author: Billorean
text:
What a travesty this is. I adore RDR1, it's one of the finest games ever. GTA V (despite the shark cards) is also a work of art. How did it go so wrong Rockstar?
At it's core, this is still basically a very good game, but it is equalled by it's flaws. I had ignored as much as I could of this game waiting for PC, and yet I buckled after 6 months, paid stupid money for it on XOne, hated it after a few hours purely (or so I thought) for having to use a controller.
So far, I have I had 20-30 hours of side questing just disappear from my singleplayer save, but my lust to play this edged me on to the online element earlier than I expected. This has proven equally frustrating. I hate myself for continuing to play, I WANT to like this game but I hate it more than I have hated a lot of games, and I've hated a LOT of games.

This game seems to have been designed to frustrate and waste the players time more than any I have ever known. The world itself, is beautiful. It is clear the artists and sfx guys have really made a rich and gorgeous world. However, we all know good graphics do NOT equal good gameplay and this is living proof of that. I'm struggling to think if I have enjoyed any mission or side quest, I really don't think I have. As I was a **** to get this on the Rockstar launcher I have created this account to review the game as opposed to Steam. I hate it THAT much. I do not deny Rockstar make wonderous sandboxes but this falls incredibly short of their high standards. The random crashes to desktop on launch I can handle, it's to be expected from Rockstar. It's the gameplay or lack of it that makes me hate this game. The amount of time wasting this game expects of the player is absurd, the best example is skinning an animal, a 5 second anitmation each time, not skippable. There are 'story' missions for online, but you need to matchmake to play them, this isn't PUBG or COD, for a game barely two weeks old I have waitied minutes at a time for cruddy missions with a cutscene no-one cares for. Fail it, and it could take 10's of minutes to 'just get it done', the fun disappears very quickly when relying on 3 people you do not know, nor communicate with. I am utterly convinced Rockstar detests solo players. I felt that from GTA V online and here it is amplified.

Now let's cover aiming, a LOT of people, myself included wanted m&k aiming, the graphics were secondary. The aiming in this is almost 50/50 whether you can be accurate and almost seems 50/50 whether you will actually shoot when you click the mouse button. Not to mention the typical bizarre control setup from Rockstar. Sometimes you try to shoot and the character won't even draw a gun. To do the 'survival' and eat food and tonics for stamina, health and dead eye is far too convoluted, in the heat of battle you just button press and select stuff hoping it's what you want, there is absolutely no fluidity to it. It's like Ark without the big green text, though Ark was more fluid to do what you wanted.

I really could go on and on about how much I hate this game, the really annoying thing is I will likely continue to torture myself with it for if nothing else but to justify buying it. Even if bought on Steam it is likely it will take longer than 2-3 hours to realise how flawed this game is. I really am gobsmacked how this is such an un-fun game. I'm giving it 5/10 purely for art direction, there is no fun in this game, or at least very, very little. Very genuinley I don't remember enjoying any of it in 40+ hours. The 'challenges' are rigged so as to only be completeable in story mode, after you've completed the story, thus pointless.

The online challenges.... ride the train for 1000 miles, one lap of the main part of the map seems to be around 2 miles, that's a challenge alright, a challenge of patience for a pathetic reward, I say reward, I believe it's a buckle worth about $15 in game, that's enough to refill your ammo, not much else.

The launch issues will get fixed, but the terrible gameplay will not. My only solace left is that RedM turns this into a playable game but I fear it will be saturated by salt and only the big streamers will find good times.

Rockstar bring out one game every 5 years, I've been a staunch fan of theirs since GTA 1. I will not be buying their next game on release and definitely will not be buying it 2 or 3 times like this and GTA V. The bigger they are the harder they fall, and they have fallen off Everest with this release. I thoroughly regret buying it and despise the hours I've played as almost entirely pi$$sed of for the duration.

If you must, 100% I would wait for a sale, there are many games out there that are fun and much more worthy of your attention.

author: GamesInsight
text:
So this review will cover the actual game score and not the issues people have with the game!

Red Dead Redemption 2 when it came out in 2018 on consoles, was the best open world game you could ever experience.
The gamne beats any other (open world) title in almost every categorie.
Rockstar really put many effort in creating this game, with its many characters, gameplay, and outstanding graphics.

So when you usually play an open world title, you may know, that some things are quiet cut off, as creating an open world, that is highly believable, has high end graphics and on top an excellent story is almost impossible to do. There were few games in the past, that could come close to this, but none of them is as big and as detailled as Red Dead Redemption 2. Not even the Witcher 3 can handle all of it that well,

But lets start with the technical details.
On PC the game looks pretty much the best you can get on any game you could name. The world is so detailled in everything, that it is amazing how much effort Rockstar has taken to get this cranked up for the PC version. Of course this comes with a high price. Many people are complaining about crashes and low performance on their rigs and not even get to 60fps.
I can only tell you the numbers that could explain this:

If we take the steam Hardware Survey, Following Hardware which is capable of 2k in High-Ultra (with fps between 40-60fps) is used there.

1080ti 1,56%
RTX 2070Super 0,25%
RTX 2080 0,88%
RTX 2080 Super < 0,15%
RTX 2080Ti 0,54%
Titan RTX < 0,15%

Lets give the Cards below 0,15% the benfit of the doubt and count tham as 0,15% and then this makes

3,53% of all Steam Users have a graphics card that could possibly handle the game in 2K at 40-60fps almost maxed out, with little things set to High (like Water Details).

Considered that 96,5 % of the gamers on PC dont even own at least a 1080ti it is just ridiculous how they expect the game to run on Ultra on their rigs.
So compared to any other game, the performace / detail ratio in Red Dead Redemption 2 is fine for me, as I do not know any other game that comes close to these details an graphics at all ... and I played all AAA games the last 10 years!

Also you have to be aware, that you need to be able to set up your rig, with knowledge, which not even 1% of the gamers are having. I built so many rigs for friends and people I know alone, and they have decent rigs, but no knowledge about their insides.

So yes, Rockstar needs to work on that, but its not a general flaw ... more the lack of decent Hardware and knowledge about how to setup your PC.
We have to admit, that this game benchmarks current generation of Hardware and maybe the next one.

I left out the CPUs, because the CPU is not a bottleneck on your PC if you have a rig, that is supporting these named Graphic Cards, so you can leave that out. Otherwise the percentage of the capable rigs will be even lower!

So much for the 0 ratings because of performance.
I play it on a 1080ti on Ultra at 1440p and get decent 40-60fps. With a good G-Sync Display it runs smooth enough and rarely drops fps.

Coming to the Sound, which is awesomly designed as well. There is no ... literally no NPC that has really poor voice or texts, which is also very rare on an open world game that scale. Even the last dude, that most likely not even 1% of the players will find is done extremely well.
The animals are having very good sounds and also realistic ones. It must have taken months to capture them all.
Also environment sounds of horses, Same is with wagons or trains.

The world just feels alive in every bit of what you can name. I even saw an Opossum that ran beside me, and as itr recognized me, it faked death ... breathtaking.

When it comes to Gameplay, well this is kind of a taste thing. As this is a rating for the PC version I have to say, that the controls are designed for Controllers. Keyboard and Mouse are done very good, but it has many Keys mapped for any specific things you can do, and does not the very best job in terms of intuition.
When it comes to the plaing of the game, it is also here outstanding choice. The amount of things you can do is also outstanding. From cooking, to crafting, to playing mini games in bars, to shaving, to cleaning your horse, do tasks in your camp, fishing, hunting ... name it and you can do it.

The story is just the way Rockstar does it. Its not the very best in all video games, but its a thrilling, believable homage to the end of the wild west time and it is finished satisfying with closing the gap to Red Dead Redemption 1.

In the end you will be left with the Multiplayer, that is out since 1 year now and went through a lot of improvements. PC Players have the advantage to had the consoles do the Beta testing, and Rockstar being reacting to the whishes out of that.

Overall a Masterpiece.

author: originalreviews
text:
I had to create an account to vent my frustration on this game. The game testing they did on this is actually completely insulting to me personally considering the size of their company and the amount of money i wasted on this game which in certain scenes in IMPOSSIBLE to keep above 60 fps on ANY settings.

I'll try to get through the positives briefly;  the world is wonderfully built and the attention to detail is amazing, the story is Ok so far and so are the animations. Good job, all this also applied to real life, so no game necessary. End of positives.

If you are the kind of person who wants to achieve or feel anything in life avoid this game. It is the epitome of everything the media tells you that you want but makes you feel nothing inside and you try to defend it because you spend £69.99 on it. The missions are completely identical, boring, easy and require zero original thought whatsoever to complete. Getting from mission to mission is tedious and so is everything else and the moment you start to get immersed in the world doing your own thing you'll have a major FPS drop, lose immersion and realize you are just a **** playing a game for children even though it's completely toxic and 18+.

I've had zero...i think they are called 'feelings' ...moments regarding the game play, I could complete the hardest level in this game while eating my dinner. Missions provide zero room for initiative, something that Rockstar pioneered to the mainstream open world audience. (not actually pioneered)

I almost think that Rockstar sabotaged this launch on purpose so they can justify to themselves not releasing there next GTA game on PC, because obviously its too much hassle to entertain people that aren't children and actually scale optimisation across multiple devices. This is also backed by the fact that they bait everyone into buying consoles by releasing on them first and i wouldn't be surprised if they did a deal with nvidia to **** up this launch to cross-sell them more of their next gen GPUs. If you think that is paranoid, then why do you think they release on consoles a whole year before PC? To get pc gamers to buy consoles obviously...
" Why should you have the best gaming experience possible, when I can have more money and do less work? THAT WOULD BE STUPID WOULDN'T IT, YOU IDIOT CONSUMER, YOU WORM !!"

Cleaning out my hard drive of this garbage to so i can play games that don't take up ludicrous amount of time from my personal projects and work or having to do doing mundane things and make me brain dead from hand holding missions and garbage stranger encounter. I have better stranger encounters in real life.

4/10 is generous based on this PC launch. If it  ran well i'd give it higher score because it would be a marvelous technical feat, although, it is not because that's like saying i'm the first man on mars, but the message is pre-recorded and i died a painful death during entry where my eye balls filled with blood and the vessels in my brain exploded due to G-force limits, Unacceptable.

If they can return my money I might consider buying the game again once it's been trough several months worth of patches, but that'll depend on if Rockstar will do the right thing and help me out. author: Leandro_Aco
text:
Es la primera reseña que escribo y da pena ver malas calificaciones a el juego sacadas totalmente de contexto de lo que el juego es, puteando al launcher o a problemas que se solucionaron al cabo de 2 o 3 días! sin siquiera tener el tiempo de pasarse el juego, es muy triste,y como minimo espero q si son tan quisquillosos lo sean así de intolerantes con todos los juegos y **** fin mi valoración esta basada en los siguiente:
-Historia: Simplemente increíble, rozando lo perfecta, a la par de intensa que The last of us, que para mi siempre fue la mejor hasta ahora, es cuanto a profundidad de personajes y la forma que te mete el la piel de los mismos y simpatizar con ellos. No quiero agregar mas sobre esto para no caer en spoiler, por si alguien verdaderamente lee esto no quiero arruinarles esta hermosa experiencia, Es simplemente increible
-Gráficos y Entorno: En cuanto a los gráficos, son escandalosos, es por momentos apabullante su mundo, que conspira de una forma tan perfecta con su narrativa. De nuevo con las comparaciones, desde The Witcher 3 no me pasaba el ir por ahí y de un momento a otro prestar atención al entorno  decir "QUE MARAVILLA, como corno hicieron esto!" y es que todo lo que te rodea durante todo el put... juego es impresionante, desde las postales que te quedan de las montañas, lo sombrío de los pantanos, la paz que dan esas llanuras, y una especie de magia que hay por la noche el los pueblos y la ciudad Principal, Es sencillamente EXTRAORDINARIO.
Duración: Lo acabo de chequear y es exactamente 58 hs 09 min, centrado solo en la historia principal mas alguno de esos eventos aleatorios pero casi ninguno. Ni siquiera se de que trata el online, Pero no soy de jugar los online de los juegos por eso no entra en mi valoración personal
Jugabilidad: es un poco mas compleja que en gta, y se **** en adaptarse los controles teniendo que muchas veces apretar mas de 3 teclas para realizar una acción pero los asimilas rápido, los tiroteos se sienten muchísimo mas reales y espectaculares que en otro juegos de Rocks Star
-RENDIMIENTO! : SI es un juego pesado, y NO no lo juegue en ultra 4K 60 FPS. Lo juegue en una de las opciones de "equilibrado" mas altas que combina opciones en Alto, Medio y Ultra de una manera genial, (tengo una RTX 2060 super,  Ryzen 3600 y 16 GB de ram) a 60 FPS prácticamente ininterrumpidos salvo por algún bajón a 50-55 muy puntual sobre todo en la zona del pantano, y es que mucha gente esta enojada porque el contador de FPS no se les dispara a mas de 100 pero habría que poner,creo yo mas atención al juego que al msi afterburner, y es que en la configuración en la que jugué yo que no es ni de cerca la mas alta lo se, LE PASA EL TRAPO A CUALQUIER OTRO JUEGO!!! POR DIOOOSS déjense de joder con estupideces y disfrutenlo! Que vale tanto la pena jugarlo por mas que sea en bajo y con los 100 filtros raros esos que tiene desactivados. El juego es HERMOSO.
P/D: EL LAUNCHER ES UNA MIERDA! Y YA ME TIENEN LAS PELOTAS POR EL PISO CON ELLOS! Para que? es realmente necesario? de verdad piensan que llenando de launcherS el PC vamos a estar mas conformes? que nos gusta tener 60 mil aplicaciones de mierda que SIEMPRE FUNCIONAN MAL para guardar 1 juego en cada una? que tienen en la cabeza? Evitan comisiones a STEAM pero se acarrean un puto 3.7 de nota Giles!!. Solo por esto le quería quitar dos puntos, pero creo que es mierda de la empresa y no de lo que yo estrictamente estoy calificando que es el juego que es una maravilla.
En fin, me pase el juego después de un hype de mas de un año que salio en consolas y la verdad sobrepaso por mucho mis expectativas. Hace mucho que no sentía que pague demasiado barato un juego caro.

author: TheGaminNorway
text:
The PC port of this game is a joke, we are now over a week since the launch, and literally no issues have been fixed. Rockstar have released patches to fix the game for some people, but somehow managed to screw it up for others in the process leaving just as many players with an unplayable game. it constantly crashes and got alot of performance issues. By whatever reason, Nvidia pascal performs extremely bad, a 1070 is about on par with a RX 580 8gb. And my 2070 super is about on par with a RX 5700, optimization for nvidia is clearly lacking. (Im not even gonna get into the optimization issue with this game now, because everyone knows this game is badly optimized just like GTA5 was, hopefully that will also get fixed eventually.) But AMD is having huge issues aswell, i have a RX 580 4gb in one system and a RTX 2070 super in another, both suffers from the same exact crashing problem. I cant even get halfway thru the benchmark without a crash, i have contacted rockstar about the issue, and their replies is so useless im 100% convinced that head of rockstar have told R support to not admit there is anything wrong with this game. and as Gamers Nexus retweeted my tweet with here, rockstar should be ashamed for their absolute garbage customer support. It is actually so bad that rockstar dont even answer the tickets with individual replies, they just copy paste their replies. I see that there is players without any issues, and well... Good for you, but the amount of people that is having issues is still so huge that rockstar cant be excused or defended even if it works for you. If this wasent a wide spread HUGE issue, would rockstar copy paste their replies? No they wouldnt. Rockstar needs to stop releasing these half finished games, i never thought i was ever gonna say this. But we have reached a point in PC gaming, where UBISOFT have passed rockstar in reliability and optimization with their games at launch.

And lets not even start on how rockstar refuses to give players a refund and the false advertising they did with the recommended specs. I truly hope that rockstar meant the game to be played with their recommended specs and just completely **** up the optimization, we`ll find out soon enough if this was false advertising to sell more games or not.

I loved this game on my PS4 and couldnt wait to get it on PC, but the PC version of this game has been such a huge disappointment. If you want this game, wait until Christmas, maybe by then rockstar would have gotten their head out of their a$$ and fixed the issues with this game and the utterly useless launcher they released way to early.

2- Anything causes someone to report you and have to lose money paying for the reward.
3- Every mission has bugs and glitches.
4- Conflict with gangs you always die because the life system is horrible.
5- You spend more time getting around the map than actually playing.
6. The legendary animal hunting system has tracking flaws and if you hunt the animal and die for anything, you simply lose the animal.
7- It is impossible to commit crimes without having to deal with witnesses (idiot).

Anyway, the game has a beautiful setting and a cool story, but if it were just for that I would rather see a movie, NOT A GAME.

The cool thing is that as I played for more than two hours, I can't  get refunded. Congratulations RockStar for fooling me into making me buy a game that isn't fit to play.

Events frequently overlap and create unreasonable in game scenarios such as wolves attacking you just as you enter a boss battle or getting a witness when you are looting the scene of a showdown. Also the economy is weird and you only seem to be able to sell items of any type to a fence at one location on the map. Weapons obtained cannot be sold ever, it is not clear why. All in all could have been done better for me.

text:
PC version is such a complete farce. You could get lucky and play the game perfectly with no issues in single player or online, or you could have an unplayable mess from a game that is already a year old. The servers are a mess and can't handle anywhere near the capacity necessary, and the game itself has serious problems, that require external programs and dumb solutions to even mitigate, let alone fix.

Not to mention the online side of the game adopts the same greedy, cash grabbing balancing system that we all know and love from Rockstar, with large parts of the system locked behind a hard ~2 week daily grind without paying extra for. But don't worry, you can buy literally everything with gold (premium currency), from weapon upgrades, to entirely new weapons, to flat out raw power horse upgrades and so on, there's nothing in the game you can't buy or make significantly easier with the premium currency.

author: AODqw97
text:
Created account to oppose the negativity. It's simple, if you're a PC gamer and you a) understand the inherent issues that will bring and b) have a PC that meets the specification then you will reap the reward for playing the game on the best platform available. I get sick to death of reading negative reviews from people without sufficient knowledge or understanding of  the difference between console and PC platforms claiming the PC version is broken and or unplayable,  it's not, but maybe your ability or your hardware IS !
My wife and I ordered the ultimate edition through R* launcher and on release day hers crashed with 'Rockstar launcher has exited unexpectedly ' so with 5 minutes of adjustments added a command line switch if -windowed and then switched to full screen once in game.
She now plays at 3440x1440 at around 60fps on the minimum spec card (ATI RX480) and 16G RAM on a 3rd gen i7.
We've played for the last 5 days and aside from a few disconnects the experience has been amazing.  We did note that after R*'s first path the command line switch was no longer needed so everything's good. A big bonus came from the unexpected level of maturity from 'most,' of the online players too. Aside from the odd KOS **** people do seem to have embraced the concept of 'live and let live' which I really didnt expect, maybe a reflection of the maturity level that comes with the better platform? Dont like what I'm saying for whatever reason? Then ask yourself why not, maybe you're one of those that shouldn't be around a PC, that's what consoles are for..
Well done Rockstar, RDRII is an absolute masterpiece that was well worth the wait.

author: LVC1VS
text:
Сначала о хорошем:
+ Игра очень красивая: великолепные пейзажи, погода, городки, NPC и животные - все выглядит очень красиво и реалистично.
+ Реалистичные физика и анимация: ткани, снег, движения животных и персонажей сделаны на фантастическом уровне.
+ Детальность проработки поражает воображение: видно, с какой любовью подошли те, кто занимался созданием мира RDR2, и как пытались максимально уйти от игровых условностей в сторону большей реалистичности.
+ Лично у меня нет претензий к оптимизации, игра отлично идет на средне-высоких в Full HD на моем R5 2600 + RX 580 8Gb, никаких фризов, вылетов, просадок ФПС я не испытываю.

Теперь о плохом:
− Тотально убогое и неудобное управление. Настолько, что за несколько часов игры у меня пару раз случился rage quit. Простейший пример: Артур устал, игра подсказывает в нижнем правом углу зажать кнопку Е чтобы отдохнуть. По нажатию Е Артур зачем-то хватает за горло стоящего рядом мужика. Приходится с ним драться, это видят свидетели, прибегает шериф и убивает Артура. Вообще случайно встрять в конфликт в этой игре проще простого. Задеть кого-то на лошади, столкнуться с выезжающим из-за угла дилижансом, задеть плечом прохожего, случайно нажать не ту кнопку (кнопка удара лошади находится по соседству с "погладить").
− Совершенно издевательская система save/load и случайных миссий. Вы встретили на пути какую-то сцену перестрелки и вас убили? Больше вы ее не увидите и не узнаете какую-нибудь интересную деталь об этом мире. Автосохранения зачем-то срабатывают после смерти. На кой черт бы я захотел снова загрузиться уже ПОСЛЕ того, как провалил случайную миссию?
− Совершенно убогий UI, заставляющий порой нажимать по несколько кнопок одновременно для выполнения каких-то простейших действий. Чтобы восстановить здоровье едой надо зажать Tab, нажать R, выбрать мышкой нужную еду и отпустить Tab. R* серьезно, вы не смогли придумать ничего лучше?

Сочетание плохого управления с поломанной системой сохранений является убийственной для игры. Мало того, что вы легко наделаете глупостей с таким управлением, так еще и не сможете загрузиться чтобы это исправить. Игра просто не дает игроку второго шанса. Можно заново начать миссию из меню, но только для ачивки лучшего ее прохождения, на сюжет это уже никак не влияет.

author: NamelessBear
text:
Shame, as I thoroughly enjoyed the PS4 version.

Was hoping to spend more time on Red Dead Online on PC but in the short time i was able to play on days 1 and 2, framerate was choppy and the game crashed every so often. Finally, on day 2 (day after launch day), it crashed for the final time for me and I joined the many players facing the 'exited unexpectedly' error on the Rockstar launcher, unable to launch the game.

Rockstar support has been mostly unresponsive and unhelpful when they do respond, telling me to update the launcher which did absolutely nothing for me.

I'm writing this review on 10 November 2019, 5 days after the PC launch, and I am still unable to play a game I paid full price for. Not even the single-player mode. It baffles me how something like this can happen. To make things worse, Rockstar has not issued any apology for this mess.

My advice to anyone reading this is to give this game a hard miss. Rockstar promised a working game on 5 November 2019 and did not deliver. True, a few lucky ones are able to play without much issues, but ask yourself if you feel lucky (well, do ya, punk?). They are clearly in damage control now, though they might never admit it, and it looks like they have a long way to go to get everyone in the game, and an even longer one for optimised performance.

text: Game worked for exactly 4 hours on the first day, then Rockstar out out patches to the game itself and the launcher and I havent been able to launch the game since. So I am out 80 bucks and have a completely broken unplayable game! This is by far the worst game launch Ive seen in my 20+ years of PC gaming. I have reported Rockstar and Epic games to the FTC (Federal Trade Commission) and I highly suggest you all do the same if you're game is broken and you are also unable to get your money back. Rockstar should be absolutely embarrassed and ashamed of themselves.....even though they aren't. The fact that they have been almost radio silent and are only posting impersonal BS tweets from Rockstar Support that say "they are working on it" tells me that they knew the game wasn't going to work on many PC's and just planned on releasing it anyway and riding out the storm in silence. Disgraceful.

author: AndreOF
text: For everyone having stutter in Read Dead Redemption 2. Limit your framerate to 60 frames using riva turner then you'll have a smooth experience. My extra tip is look how much of your graphics card percentage are being used, if it's being used below 85% percent increase the resolution instead of putting everything on ultra for a more crisp image quality and if you don't know how to do it look on the internet for DSR(Dynamic Super Resolution) it's quite simple to **** 85% is to guarantee for the most demanding parts of the game that you'll have extra power to avoid stutters. I personally never had CTD or things like that but my stutter completely gone with this tip and my game is looking awesome. If this helps you let me know. Cheers.

author: Locke1318
text:
I am very frustrated with Take Two Interactive/Rockstar Games. I spent over 200$ to upgrade my pc to the recommended specifications and I am met with severe cpu spiking and constant freezes that make the game unplayable. The settings do not scale properly to allow better performance. There are many issues and bugs. I can't even properly lower my resolution without bugs appearing.

Being patronized by Rockstar to "update my drivers" was a bad move. I feel a strong presence of corporate interference with this launch. I get the impression from take two that they struck a deal with gpu companies (nvidia, amd) to coerce more players into buying high end gpu's. I'm angry that I spent money on recommended (which in my mind means 60fps at med-high settings) hardware that turns out to be subpar even on some of the lowest settings. The game runs even worse at lower settings.

There needs to be some type of recourse for these publishers that pressure developers into pushing out subpar product. I for one will never preorder another Rockstar title after this disappointment.

I built a pc based off the prediction of this release 2 years ago, and for this to fail as hard as it is and to be given a patronizing response over obvious greed is a real bummer.

Shame on you Take Two/Rockstar!

A couple of hours into multiplayer, I had a little fun messing around with a buddy, but about every 15-20 minutes I'm getting disconnected from the server. The worst thing about the game for me at the moment, though, is constant freezes (In single player and multiplayer). Freezes happen once every minute or two and last 5-15 seconds. It's so frustrating it's not even playable. I have a nice rig, but I'm running everything on the lowest graphical settings just to try to stop freezes. I've followed every suggestion Rockstar has put up on their website to no avail.

Really wish I had my $60 back. Rockstar has lost all goodwill it has built up with me over the years. They're just another declining video game company not interested in their fanbase and trying to cash out as much as possible. Sad.

author: RedDeadFail
text:
Exited 'expectedly'!

The worst AAA launch in history, 72 hours later and the game is still unplayable.  Only got a response on my support ticket as I emailed Sam Houser directly. Brief acknowledgement and now back to radio silence.  R* should be ashamed, taken millions of $ from people without delivering a product, this could only happen in the gaming world.

It's a disgrace and having bought most of the R* titles down the years, I will never give them money again.  They haven't even publicly acknowledged their failures, they just keep releasing patches that DON'T fix the game.

I bet their QA/Test Lead is **** himself currently and rightly so.  Whilst I appreciate PC releases have a complexity attached on release which differs from consoles but this experience stinks of a team that hasn't tested properly.  I've never had this experience with ANY other pre-ordered or purchased game.

The fact that Gaming Media have effectively buried the issue and CNET releasing some nonsense article stating the 'majority of problems are fixed' - I don't believe it, I suspect R* have reached out as a damage limitation exercise and these **** journalists have agreed so as to not risk getting future pre-releases for review.

If I could give a minus score I would.

Finally, their 14 day refund policy is a joke, thieving scumbags.

author: L0RD-SILVER
text:
This game is great so far. I have no issues with i7 4790k, GTX 1080 and 24GB ram. I thought first that the game not working on ultra is a very big deal for me, but after spending some time tweaking my settings I saw that I can have great graphics with great performance, too. This game is just demanding, this is not about optimization, it has a lot of demanding things like volumetric lightning, fog, clouds, smoke, things that can be seen even at lowest settings (for those who are wondering why is still demanding at low), even more by being a huge open-world with lots of high-res foliage, mountains, water, etc.

My settings: imgur . com / a / Uwrn6NF (delete spaces to be able to copy that link)
The only difference from the photos is that I went with Vulkan, because I saw that I get a 2-6 FPS increase. Now, with Vulkan and those settings, my game goes minimum at 60 FPS, mostly over, it stays in the range of 60-85 FPS. You should benchmark both APIs and see with each one you get a better performance.

I can understand those who have problems (game not working or stuttering) and I hope they fix those issues, but I didn't have none.

The graphics give this game an extraordinary atmosphere (and all those clouds/fog/smoke/weather effects), the horse mechanics are great, it's interesting that you can fall with him and other things like that. Probably is the best looking PC game at the moment. It's very fun just walking around with your horse. You have multiple customization options for you, your horse, you can buy different horses and other things. I love it!

author: Blindness_Alt_S
text:
#Read the review before downvoting or ignoring this comment, please#

13 months of waiting, 1,5 hours of decrypting the game 2 seconds after the game was relatively available to play, 10 minutes of installing 3 GB of garbage files to "validate" the game files and two full hours with 2 crashes, the failed benchmark option that took me straight to the main screen, and the two  next days trying to fully process why I spent my well earned 60 bucks on this rushed, insanely poor optimized masterpiece.

Didnt complain about the vomitive ports we received 11 years ago with GTA IV and Bully on Steam, nor with the awful L.A. Noire 30 FPS cap, even I tolerated that GTA V was launched 1,3 years after the next gen and we didnt received nothing but in-game premium currency and non-single-player content,  but this is a real FCKING shame and Rockstar owes the PC Community a million apologizes. A million.

Not only we do have to wait one more year to see our GOTY wishlist games to be launched to our devoted platform, but we also have to be content with a shady developer whose prime directives consists on signing exclusive contracts to see them endorsed to the console platforms for 1 full year and abusing their 2 latest releases (excellent on single-player content) to see them only focused on their dull online attributes.

My setup consists on a pretty decent 1660Ti, plus a bit outdated i5 7400 plus 16 GB of RAM. The joke about this? The most sterile scene in the game, and the first, some snowy planes, brings death to my FPS. 40 frames per second on Low-Mid settings? Impossible...

If you wish to see this game bloom and get to a healthy state of performance, keep post abismal reviews and Twitter, so maybe R* becomes fully aware of this tremendoulsy terrible issue and they finally update the game with a quality-of-life patch, not  like the futile placebo composed by 5 minor fixes thay they made 48 hours ago.

author: Keks2425
text:
К 1899 году эпоха стрелков и бандитов подходила к концу. Америка превращалась в страну законов… Даже Дикий Запад был, по большей части, укрощен.

Начало игры погружает нас в атмосферное зимнее место похожее из фильма Квентина Тарантино «Омерзительная Восьмерка».

После того, как мы не без проблем и с неким количеством перестрелок миновали зимний участок локации, нам открываются без крайние зеленые поля схожие из одной истории фильма «Легенда Бастера Скраггса». Это и нравится мне в игре больше всего, что почти в каждом её уголке открытого мира можно найти соответствие из мест фильмов про дикий запад.

Ощущение от игры такое, будто ты не просто играешь и погружаешься с головой в ту эпоху дикого запада, а читаешь очень качественную книгу, произведение. В общем, сюжет чем то напомнил мне великую игру «Mafia: The City Of Lost Heaven». Не торопливый, но правильно поданный сюжет с постепенно раскрывающимися персонажами. История, рассказывающая о последствиях, от которых уже не убежать.

То, что спустя время части геймеров игра по какой то мере не зашла или не понравилась. То это абсолютно нормально. Изначально жанр «Вестерн» адаптируется к относительно небольшой аудитории и любят его смотреть не все. Поэтому если вы не любитель фильмов о диком западе и любите скорее динамичные игры, то эта игра, вам, скорее всего не подойдет.

Если вы раньше не играли в такие игры, то от части советую поиграть вам в игру «GUN» и «Call of Juarez». Эти игры есть на торрентах. Поэтому оголять кошелек чтобы почувствовать дух дикого запада в этот раз не нужно. Если же и они вам не зашли. То могу с уверенностью сказать, что RDR 2 — не для вас.

Подводя итоги, могу сказать, что у компании «Rockstar Games» получился один из самых взрослых и драматичных созданных ими игр. Технически проработанных и сюжетно правильных как ГТА 4.
10/10

And boy am I glad I did not refund it.

This is, hands down, the most beautiful, most finished, interactive open world game I've ever played.
When it works, It's just stunning. The way the world is alive with great characters with depth, the way you naturally bond with your horse... It's just amazing.

You eat, drink, sleep, get dirty and get to choose how you want to live your cowboy life. Be the good guy, the bad guy, something in the middle. It's up to you and all your actions seem to affect the world and how people interact with you.

So yeah, I get people 0 bombing this game with reviews for not being able to play it and rockstar is the devil for forcing there own crappy game launcher, but the game itself deserves a straight up 10!

author: keredd1010
text:
A lot crying and a lot of whining and justifiably so. I just don't think you should express that by giving the game an awful rating. I myself was one of the ones plagued with the infamous "Rockstar launcher has quit unexpectedly" and I was cursing up a storm as it took me a few hours to troubleshoot and get it working. I work in IT so I can imagine it being even more frustrating for people who lack my experience. But judging a game before you even get to play is just plain stupid.

Once I got the game going I was able to judge the most important factor (IMO) that differentiates this from the console version which had that GODAWFUL  aim/gun play system. It was absolutely terrible.  If you tried to play it without auto aim it was so frustrating and auto aim made the gun play so boring. That is now gone with mouse aiming and now first person shootout are SO much fun. Of course everyone knows graphically and storywise the game is wonderful and that carries over here.

I stop short of giving this game a 10 for two main reasons. 1) the awful launch issues and bugs and the terrible graphical optimization when they said you needed a GTX 1060. HA! What a joke! My 2060 super struggles to get 60 fps at 1440p on high settings. Hopefully, this gets addressed with patches. 2) This has been an issue with Rock* for a while and that is the dated mission design. It lacks variety and its very much on rails design where you have to do the mission EXACTLY like they want you to kinda takes you out of the immersion.

I feel bad for the people who couldn't get this working. I really do and I hope it works for you but please don't give **** 0 ratings when you haven't even played the game. It's childish and immature. Game is a masterpiece and MUCH better on PC than console.

text:
The PC version works really well. First I had crashes on startup which was caused by Bitdefender Advanced Threat Detection. Adding an exception for the game solved the problem. The game runs really well on my 2080 Ti. Playing on 4k with Ultra settings and around 40 fps.

You can safely ignore the trolls who complain about the game not running at 60 fps in 4k with Ultra settings. The developers recommended Medium-High settings for 4k 60 fps (see the Nvidia article). Other games like Shadow of the Tomb Raider also doesn't hadle 60fps when you max out the settings on 4k. Even so, 4k Ultra settings at 40 fps is still way ahead of playing this on a console that uses Medium-High with fake 4k and 30 fps. The PC version is a big step up in visuals.

author: Savoz
text:
Luckily the game works for me, but its so poorly optimized that I cannot find a balance between good visual quality and acceptable framerates. Its been 2 days after release and I haven't even started the story yet, I'm just trying my luck with the settings and running the in game benchmark again and again.
I've tested it with RX 580, GTX 1060 & GTX 1080 and the results are so poor that I don't even want to play this game on PC. RX 580 & GTX 1060 can't even maintain 30fps @ 1080p at high-ultra settings while I get over 80fps on max settings @ 1080p in Call of Duty Modern Warfare which is also just released. And GTX 1080 which will easily give you over 60fps @ 2k Ultra settings in almost every game, can't run this game 60fps @ 1080p. I've been getting 45fps @ 1080p Ultra with GTX 1080. This just makes me not want to play it on PC, and I've spent over 8hrs by just testing benchmark so I can't even refund the game :(
P.S: I love RDR2 alot, its one of the best games of all time and I really enjoyed playing it on PS4 Pro even though it had blurry graphics on it but still it worked fine. I pre-order again on PC just to play it on Max settings but optimization is so bad that its just ain't gonna work, even though I have the right hardware to run it.

author: DaemonXHUN
text:
RDR 2 is possibly one of the worst optimized games I've ever seen.

An Xbox One X has a GPU that is roughly on par with an overclocked AMD RX580 and it can run the game at native 4K (3840x2160) at an almost rocks solid 30FPS.

An Nvidia RTX 2080Ti is is generally 144-173% faster than an AMD RX580 in open world games with high simulation complexity (such as GTA V and The Witcher III), according to UserBenchark.

Of course, consoles are closed systems that are specifically designed for gaming so developers can use the available resources there more effectively, but Red Dead Redemption 2 also has low level API on PC (Vulkan), so the game should scale relatively similarly to the example above.

---

Which means that even if we are just counting with 100% faster performance instead of 144-173% (so we are very conservative), the game should run at a locked 60 FPS on equivalent to console settings (with maybe some slight dips to 58-59).

If we are not that conservative though and if were are counting with 144-173% performance scaling, the game should run between 73 and 81 FPS, with maybe slight dips to 69-70 FPS.

But instead, it runs roughly at 40-45 FPS and can dip even down to 28 FPS.

---

The situation is even worse (way worse) - with previous generation Pascal cards, and you can expect truly atrocious performance, even if you have a GTX 1080Ti (like me).

text:
System Tested - Ryzen 5 3600 / RX 5700 XT / 16GB DDR4 3200

Seen a lot of user reviews complain about the performance so I was skeptical about what to expect.

Running at 1440p with a realistic High Preset with some settings scaled to Medium and some to Ultra, RDR2 is rock solid so far with a target of 75FPS to match the 1440p monitor refresh rate it manages to hit that for good chunks of the time. Dips below 60fps do happen but Freesync takes care of that.

Having played on PS4 the bump up in native resolution is noticable as well as the increased visual fidelity and framerate.

Very happy with the game so far and no bugs or errors have cropped up.

author: robfontiglia
text:
TL;DR : I love this ! It runs very well. I'd say for a "lower high-end" setup, you should be just fine.

This review is not about the game per se -- that's been out for a while, not much will have changed about it, I presume. But I did want to report the technical aspects of this PC ports, because what I've seen on here is pretty alarming.

Well I'm very glad to say, as far as I'm concerned, there hasn't been a bump in the road yet. The game has run smoothly from the first time that I launched it. There have been no issues at all, no crashes. The game looks great, with moderately high settings. Admittedly, I have only played two hours, in Story Mode. Most people who've had problems were saying they'd had them right from the start, though. But maybe it's different if you play Online -- I wouldn't know, because I don't care at all about online play.

Exactly what I'm running :
Windows 10 Home, 64 bits.
Core i7-4770.
16 Gb of DDR-3 RAM.
1x ASUS GTX-1070 Dual.
My Mo-bo is a proprietary Acer piece of garbage. (My whole setup is based on a prebuilt PC that I tricked out. It involved making myself a custom adapter for the weird 12-pin power-supply connector, and switching the power-supply out for a 550W unit to power the GPU. It's a bit frankenstein-ey but it works. And the prebuilt unit was pretty cheap for the parts it contained...)

I installed the latest Nvidia drivers before I ever ran the game, and you probably should too. Software-wise, I should also point out that I'm not running any special anti-virus protection. Just Windows Defender has always been plenty for me. Also, in case that's ever relevant, I bought the game from Rockstar Games Launcher directly.

Once the game started, I did have to "Alt-Tab" my way to a pop-up window asking me to set an exception in Windows Firewall for the game -- The game didn't stop running, but as I saw it flash by, I figured I might as well go ahead and allow it right then and there. Then it loaded fine, I adjusted the gamma setting, and I was on my merry way !

Game settings :
1920x1080 @ 60 fps
V-Sync on.
I went with what the game recommended. Most settings are on "High" -- some are on "Ultra", some are on "Medium". I did decrease the water physics a bit, and upped some other things that I can't remember now.
Crucially, I disabled motion blur (which has never been worth it in my book), and MSAA (because why would you) but I did allow FXAA (it's lightweight and makes a difference for me).

I would say that the game keeps up a good 60 fps, and it certainly never dips below 45. So for my money, this is waaay more than playable -- it's gorgeous, it runs smoothly, and so far, I love it.

I wanted to share this because the ever-dipping meta-critic user score on here today had me worried. People seemed to be saying that it was an awful PC port, that it was unplayable, or ridden with crashes and unfixed bugs. Well so far that has not been the case for me. As for the optimisation I don't know what the issue would be. This game's graphics, with the settings I'm running, is at least on par with the other games I run on my setup, with similar graphics settings. I'd even say it looks better than, say, AC Odyseey or Witcher 3. So Maybe the lesson here is : have realistic expectations. Maybe you won't be hable to run this at a 4k resolution, with everything on Ultra, with a GTX-1060. But your setup can be a little out-dated (as mine is), and it will still handle this beautifully. Of course, I don't know what it looked like on consoles, maybe by running these modest game settings, my game looks no better than the console version. But I don't have a console, so it's still worth it for me to play this game.

To sum up : somewhat out-dated hardware, no special software hacks. Latest drivers. Game runs like a charm at a reasonable framerate, with reasonable settings, and is very enjoyable. For me, that's a 10/10. For now.
